world_model_delta: Factions may send one MESSAGE per turn to any other faction. Format: {from_faction, to_faction, turn, content_hash, wulmoji_surface}. Content is not stored in the world model — only the hash. Messages may not transfer resources or obligations. Message hashes are simulation-local identifiers with no cross-namespace standing.
validator_question: Can the message protocol establish cross-namespace claims via content_hash reference?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: MEDIUM — content_hash links outside world model; explicit: message hashes are simulation-local, no cross-namespace standing
